messages.content:
A question about machines at work (EU machinery law, Italian law on work equipment, guidance, manuals
of specific machines, a company's list of lifting devices) could not be answered from the passages found by its own
words. Break it into the lookups needed to answer it: each lookup is one thing to find in the documents (a
definition, the article that sets a duty, the list an annex gives, the date an article applies from, what a manual
declares about a machine, the row of a table).
Return JSON only: {"lookups": ["<search words for one lookup>", ...]} with 2 to 4 lookups. Write each lookup as
the words the document itself would use, in English and in Italian together, naming the act, the article or annex
and the machine when the question names them. Do not answer the question.

Today (14 November 2026) the integrator completes the robot cell with the UR5e and UR10e arms. According to the robots' Declaration of Incorporation the integrator is responsible for the complete machine. Which steps does Article 5(1) of the act applicable today require of the integrator before the cell is put into service?

response.text: {"lookups": ["Directive 2006/42/EC Article 5(1) placing on the market and putting into service: manufacturer ensures essential health and safety requirements, conformity assessment, technical file, EU declaration of conformity, CE marking / direttiva 2006/42/CE articolo 5 paragrafo 1 immissione sul mercato e messa in servizio: fabbricante requisiti essenziali di salute e sicurezza, valutazione della conformità, fascicolo tecnico, dichiarazione CE di conformità, marcatura CE", "Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 Article 54 date of application 20 January 2027 repealing Directive 2006/42/EC / regolamento (UE) 2023/1230 articolo 54 data di applicazione 20 gennaio 2027 abrogazione della direttiva 2006/42/CE", "Directive 2006/42/EC Article 2 definition of manufacturer and partly completed machinery Annex II part B declaration of incorporation / direttiva 2006/42/CE articolo 2 definizione di fabbricante e quasi-macchina allegato II parte B dichiarazione di incorporazione", "D.Lgs. 17/2010 articolo 5 immissione sul mercato e messa in servizio delle macchine, obblighi del fabbricante / decreto legislativo 17/2010 articolo 5 comma 1 messa in servizio macchine obblighi del fabbricante e dell'installatore"]}
